title: Reconcile financial precision and ledger authority
problem: Worker 8 uses integer micros while Control Tower states integer currency minor units. Worker 7 assigns economics reconciliation to Worker 8; shared contract assigns normalized billing ledger/corrections to Managed Ops.
proposed_change: Propose exact integer micros for AI raw cost measurement with explicit unit/scale/currency; retain currency minor units at settlement. Managed Ops must define rounding, zero-decimal/three-decimal currency behavior, adjustment linking and allocation; Business Model supplies pricing policy. Worker 8 owns raw AI measurement and consumes ledger APIs; Worker 7 emits connector usage. No ambiguous wholesale_amount.
alternatives: Accept incompatible drafts without reconciliation: rejected by shared integration gate.
Owners may propose a different explicit versioned mapping with equivalent safety and evidence.
contract_impact: Requires a reviewed precision exception and owner API/payload agreement; no silent arithmetic or pricing authority shift.
security_impact: Tenant, credential and financial authority must be explicit; schemas alone do not establish runtime authorization.
cost_schedule_impact: Resolve contract drift before implementation to avoid cross-module rework; no vendor spend or deployment authorized.
migration: Affected owners revise their assigned branches; Control Tower reviews pinned revisions before selective integration.
rollback: Keep prior shared draft and source submissions; supersede the proposal if rejected.
decision_owner: Control Tower with affected module owners
